card.name: "To" after "the steps" in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "the steps" in the sentence telling patients about symptoms of serious CV events and the steps to take. All shown contexts are the same passage.

modes.label: steps to take
modes.description: The word "to" following "the steps" in a patient-counselling sentence about cardiovascular events.
modes.example: Patients should be informed about the symptoms of serious CV events and the steps<< to>> take if they occur.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated to each other, and the suppressed ones mean "unexpected" or "surprise", so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the "to" in "the steps to take" in a warning about heart-related side effects.
